name: A Claude Code session records each agent assignment as a Work item, with outcome and cost
asks: I'd love to see you the ringleader use-and-improve our agentic technologies for helping you ringlead, and your agents work more efficiently with less token cost, more tracked costs, etc.
status: open: the node and its Work operations exist and are reachable on loopback, but a Claude Code session holds no authenticated tool for them

what-a-session-can-call-today: the cost ledger and per-Work roll-up (computer-inference-system-services-section, inference-expense-ledger-services-section scripts): local files, no node needed

record-agent-assignment.mjs derive: assignments and outcomes derived from the lead transcript's Agent tool calls and task-notification statuses, appended to the assignment journal idempotently; report-work-cost.mjs prices each

node-reach.node: bare-cedar-fog-561-group.service (user unit, FeltOS/MetroPlat node, running; feltos.mjs)
node-reach.endpoint: HTTP on 127.0.0.1:18807, routed by Host header (bare-cedar-fog.561.group; any other Host answers 421). Operations are served on POST /mcp (MCP surface); /healthz, /oauth/* and /mcp are the self-admitting paths.
node-reach.authentication: /mcp answers 401 invalid_token without an OAuth bearer token. Principals on the node include emsenn, emsenn.claude and hai-jian (human accounts); client credentials sit under /run/user/1000/561-group-credentials and were not read.
node-reach.binding: computer-system-engine src/rpc/binding.mjs is the filesystem effect binding for a node serving one data root (host fs, Claude and Codex session roots, injected resolveActorSubject); it carries no listener, socket or credential, so it is not how a local process reaches operations.

measured.office-subject: An office for the Claude lead exists: the Bare Cedar Fog Claude character, given name Hai Jian, holds senior-engineer with incumbency bare-cedar-fog-claude-as-senior-engineer (2026-10-09 notes in this section). Sessions already act as Hai Jian. work-open and work-move play as the office the authenticated account holds, so the missing link is a token for that account, not an office.
missing: the project .mcp.json declares no mcpServers, so a Claude Code session has no tool named work-open or work-move, and no command here holds a bearer token for the hai-jian/emsenn.claude account

the session's hooks do not reach the node: only the PreToolUse host-resource hook is installed, so SubagentStop and SessionEnd never admit token-usage rows through metroplat's agent-hook operation (which also skips transcripts over 128 MiB)
no replay command plays the derived assignment journal into the node: work-open for each new Work id and work-move for each outcome, attaching the per-Work cost roll-up as evidence
measured.to-build: Declare the node's /mcp endpoint (http://127.0.0.1:18807 with Host bare-cedar-fog.561.group) in the project .mcp.json for the Hai Jian account with an OAuth token supplied from the credentials directory by the host, not by a script; then a replay command that plays work-open (report or aim) per derived assignment and work-move per outcome, idempotent on the Work id.

x-provenance.basis: Read of feltos server/entrance.mjs and work-arena-operations.mjs, computer-system-engine src/rpc/binding.mjs, the node's listening sockets, an unauthenticated probe of /mcp, principal account names, and the 2026-10-09 office notes; no credential was read.
